items.title: Objection deadline (Widerspruch) against Wohngeld decision
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids bei uns eingehen (Landkreis Musterspree-Neiße, Amtsplatz 3, 15848 Beispielkow); Sie können ihn schriftlich einreichen oder bei uns zur Niederschrift erklären.
items.computation: Letter printed/posted on 20.11.2026 (Friday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date given, so posting day = 20.11.2026. Delivery fiction for authorities posted from 1 Jan 2025: deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days and not counting the posting day itself: day1=21.11.(Sat), day2=22.11.(Sun), day3=23.11.(Mon), day4=24.11.2026 (Tue). This is a general authority (Landkreis, not a tax office), so the delivery day is NOT shifted even though day4 falls partly on a weekend run - 24.11.2026 is itself a Tuesday, a normal working day, so delivery = 24.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period (§187 Abs.1, §188 Abs.2 BGB, analogous to §70 VwGO/§84 SGG): the day of delivery is not counted; the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 24.12.2026. 24 December is a normal working day in Germany (per the rule that 24 and 31 December count as working days) and is a Thursday, not a Brandenburg public holiday, so no further shift applies. Deadline = 24.12.2026.
